answer: A Sybil defense uses verifiable delay proofs. Each agent must submit a timed compute commitment before its work is accepted, requiring real CPU cycles that cannot be faked. Like extracting ferrous metal from ore, the cost is physical and unavoidable. An attacker creating thousands of identities pays full compute per identity, so the economics collapse. Each proof acts as a mesa of accountability: no proof, no participation. Unlike stake systems where wealth concentrates at the summit of large operators, compute proofs keep marginal cost per identity flat, making Sybil growth unprofitable.
